title: OVER query_range has no LIMIT — client-controlled result set size
description: reader/src/store/overview.rs:119-130: query_range executes 'SELECT ... WHERE article_number BETWEEN low AND high ORDER BY article_number ASC' with no LIMIT clause. The (low, high) values come directly from the client's OVER command (lifecycle.rs:749-781). A client sends OVER 1-999999999 on a group with 100,000 articles: SQLite returns 100,000 rows, all materialized into Vec<OverviewRecord> in the session task, then serialized into a single response. With 100 bytes per overview record, this is 10MB per request, per session. Multiple simultaneous clients issuing large OVER commands can exhaust heap memory. Fix: add LIMIT ? to the SQL query and clamp (high - low) to a MAX_OVER_RANGE constant (e.g., 10,000) in lifecycle.rs, returning 501 if the requested range exceeds it.
